create_gtn_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a GTN graph by adding start and accept nodes then connecting them with labeled arcs
get_and_set_graph_weights: get arc weights as a list or numpy array and set new weights on a GTN graph
compare_gtn_graphs_for_equality: compare two GTN graphs for exact equality or structural isomorphism using gtn.equal and gtn.isomorphic
save_and_load_gtn_graphs: save a GTN graph to disk in text or binary format and load it back with gtn.savetxt and gtn.load
run_autograd_backward_on_gtn_graphs: run backward autograd on GTN graph operations like add and negate to compute gradients on arc weights
